test_gmock_class_generation: run the unittest suite that tests gmock_class C++ to Google Mock code generation
test_generate_mock_methods: test the _GenerateMethods function that converts C++ virtual methods to MOCK_METHOD macros
test_generate_full_mocks: test the _GenerateMocks function that generates complete Mock class source from C++ headers
test_ast_builder_from_source: test the ast.BuilderFromSource parser that builds an AST from C++ source code strings
test_mock_method_variants: test MOCK_METHOD generation for const methods, templated classes, default parameters, and template types
